title: HCP — Revocation Notice — payload
description: The request payload of the HCP 2.0-draft-3 revocation notification (HCP 6.2.3, 9.9): a provider tells a Context Client that a grant it held has been revoked. Carries the members of the `https://hcp.example/spec/events/grant-revoked` event; the Security Event Token claims map to the framework envelope (see the spec). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

grantId.description: The grant-revoked event's `grantId`: the grant that was revoked.

revokedAt.description: The grant-revoked event's `revokedAt`: when the provider revoked the grant. The revocation took effect then, whether or not this notice is delivered (HCP 6.2.3).

Response.title: HCP — Revocation Notice — response payload
Response.description: The client accepted the notice. Carries RFC 8935's `202 Accepted`, which has no body, so the payload is the empty object. A refusal is a trust-task-error, not this shape.
